BrochureContent.Content: Behan Irwin & Gosling are delighted to offer for sale this excellent 4 bed semi-detached house situated in this mature  residential location on the Douglas Road. The property is c.1.6km North of Douglas Village and 2.2km south of Cork City. Douglas offers amenities including two shopping centers including Tesco, Dunnes Stores, Aldi,  M&S, as well as schools and recreational facilities. The property has excellent primary and secondary schools including Lady of Lourdes, Eglantine, St Anthony’s, Christ King, Regina Mundi & Ashton.

Entrance hallway (2.47m x 0193m) 
Hardwood timber flooring, burglar alarm, radiator, centre light, fuse board, internet/telephone point and 4 power points.

Dining room (5.48m X 3.89m) 
Solid fuel fire place with matching hearth & mantle, PVC double glazed windows, curtains/curtain rails, hardwood timber flooring, radiator,  fire alarm, centre light and 4 power points.

Kitchen Area (4.39m X 2.73m)
Floor to eye level fitted units, mixer tap & drainer, timber flooring, double glazed PVC window to the rear of the property, 4 plate Normandy hob & Oven, plumbed for washing machine & tumble-dryer, extractor fan, radiator, centre light and 9 power points.

Utility Room (2.30 X 1.65m)
Timber flooring, gas boiler, PVC double glazed window looking onto the side entrance, shelving units, towel rail, centre light and 4 power points.

Pantry Area (1.3m x 1.2m)
Additional store room

Guest bathroom (2.07m X 1.28m)
Fully tiled floor to ceiling, WC,WHB, with storage units, clothes rail, radiator, centre light and PVC doubled glazed with frosted window.

Sitting room (4.07m X 3.14m)
Solid fuel open fireplace, timber flooring, PVC double glazed window looking onto the rear of the property, curtain/curtain rail, radiation, centre light and 6 power points.
 
Stairs to Landing
Fully carpeted stairs and landing, access to the attic through the landing, PVC double glazed window, centre light, light switches and 4 power points.

Main bathroom (3.11m X 1.56m)
Tiled walls to ceiling, WC, WHB, PVC doubled glazed windows with frosted privacy glass, hand assist rails, heated towel rack, electric Mira shower, extractor fan and centre light.

Bedroom 1 (3.80m x 3.16m)
Floor finished in timber floor covering, PVC double glazed window, built in wardrobe with shelving and hanging area, centre light, light switch and 4 power points.

Master bedroom (5.27m x 2.81 m)
Double built in wardrobe with shelving and hanging area, floor finished in timber floor cover, double glazed PVC windows looking onto the front of the property, centre light and 6 power points. 

Bedroom 3 (2.63m x 2.24m)
Floor finished in timber floor covering, double glazed PVC windows facing the rear of the property, built in wardrobe with shelving and hanging area, curtains/curtain rail, radiator, centre light, light switch and 3 power points

Bedroom 4 (4.18m x 2.63m)
Floor finished in timber floor covering, double glazed PVC windows facing the front of the property, double built in wardrobe with shelving and hanging area, curtains/curtain rail, radiator, centre light, light switch and 3 power points.

Outside
Front driveway finished with a cobbled stone, surfaced parking area for two vehicles, side access to the back garden, concrete garden path leading to an extensive garden shed which boasts ample room for storage alike., The back garden is meticulously maintained with a variety of plants and shrubs.

Spacious  Four bed semi-detached dwelling situated in a highly sought after residential location on the Douglas Road, adjacent to Douglas Village, Schools and Cork City Centre.
Features include off street parking, two storey extension to rear, roof replaced 2022, manicured rear garden , Gas fired central heating & PVC windows throughout.
